routes.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA), Tourist
routes.summary: Everyone needs an ETA before arriving. Citizens of 40 listed countries (plus Maldives, Seychelles and Singapore) get it free since 25 May 2026.

other: Free ETA applies to 40 listed countries, including Australia, Canada, France, India, Japan and the United States. Check the full list on eta.gov.lk.
Other nationalities follow the general ETA rules and fees, which the page did not state.
Applicants from Cameroon, Nigeria, Ivory Coast, Ghana, Afghanistan, Taiwan, Kosovo and Syria apply through a Sri Lankan sponsor.

stay.note: Free ETA is valid 30 days with double entry in that window. Maldivians get 90 days. Extensions are possible for a visa fee.

routes.name: Tourist and Business Visit Visas
routes.summary: Visit visas for holidays, family visits, medical treatment and short business trips. Single, double or multiple entry depending on type.

other: Passport valid at least six months from arrival.
Enough funds for the stay and a return or onward ticket.
Business visas cannot be extended online.

sources.label: Dept. of Immigration and Emigration, visa services

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: For short stops on the way to another country. Valid 48 hours. Needed if you wait more than 24 hours for a connecting flight.

sources.label: Dept. of Immigration and Emigration, visa services

routes.name: Residence Visas (employment, investor, student, family, medical)
routes.summary: Multiple-entry residence visas by category: employment (approved projects, BOI, banks, registered companies, Port City), investor, student, NGO, spouse and dependents of a Sri Lankan, and medical. Duration and fees were not on the page.

other: Each category has its own conditions. Check the Immigration Department.
No digital nomad or working holiday visa was found on the official pages.

sources.label: Dept. of Immigration and Emigration, visa services

routes.name: Golden Paradise Residence Visa
routes.summary: A 10-year residence visa for investors and their families. Deposit USD 200,000 in a special foreign currency account, and you can withdraw up to half after the first year.

investment.note: Deposit in a Golden Paradise Foreign Currency Account at a licensed bank. Up to 50% withdrawable after year one.

other: Police clearance from country of domicile within 6 months.
Medical report clearing malaria, filariasis, tuberculosis and HIV/AIDS.

documents: Medical report from authorized local hospital
Marriage and birth certificates for family

routes.name: My Dream Home Visa (senior residents)
routes.summary: A 2-year renewable residence visa for senior foreigners. Needs a USD 15,000 fixed deposit and monthly remittances. No work allowed. The page only covers extensions, so confirm new applications.

savings.note: Fixed deposit in an approved Sri Lankan bank.

income.note: Plus USD 750 per month for each spouse and dependent child.

other: Valid medical insurance for Sri Lanka.
Official page describes extensions for existing holders. Confirm the rules for new applicants.

fees.label: Residence visa per year per person (applicant, spouse, child over 16)

routes.name: Permanent Residence Visa (PRV)
routes.summary: For people of Sri Lankan descent, former Sri Lankan citizens, and spouses of Sri Lankan citizens married over 5 years. Card is valid up to 10 years and renewable.

other: Sri Lankan descent or former Sri Lankan citizen, or spouse (married over 5 years) of a citizen, deceased citizen or former citizen.
Children under 22 can apply as dependents.
Police clearance usually from the past year.
Spousal PRV can be lost if the marriage ends within 5 years.
